sources.provider: Taiwan e-Learning and Digital Archives Program institutional union catalog, National Central Library-supplied holding metadata
sources.quality_notes: Institutional TELDAP object 544588 distinctly labels 書號02260 / 善本書-原件 / 版本舊鈔本 / 線裝 / 16冊 / 國家圖書館 ownership and 19.7x13.8cm inner frame. TELDAP adjacent index separately labels 02261 as 綠格鈔本, independently corroborating distinct bibliographic holding IDs. TELDAP object's direct original-data link presently opens the NCL search landing page rather than an item-specific official detail record, so this object does NOT independently establish 周印星詒 glyphs, the older Commons/NCL transcribed collection marks, any 1619 text or target 改造漏刻 leaf. Two catalog providers/URLs do NOT create two physical copies. Catalog metadata license notices are not permission to republish facsimile images. No inquiry, download or new historical glyph.
